title: Evidence topology and epistemic root cuts
problem: Multiple checkpoint PASS states can reuse the same underlying evidence and create an illusion of independent confirmation.

model.witness: parallel support path for one checkpoint role
model.source_root: primitive dependency whose failure invalidates every witness that declares it
model.role_root_cut: minimum number of source roots whose removal invalidates all usable witnesses for a required role
model.certificate_root_cut: minimum role_root_cut across all required PASS roles

one_witness_requiring_raw_data_and_analy.reason: series dependency: either primitive root can invalidate the witness

invariants: Four PASS roles supported by one root are not four independent confirmations
Parallel independent witnesses increase root-cut robustness
A certificate is only as root-robust as its weakest required role
boundary: Declared roots encode a dependency model. Root-cut robustness measures structural dependence, not scientific effect size or truth probability.
